soundness_flags.label: lem:terminal-synthesis-invariance and thm:bow-rowspan-iff
soundness_flags.one_line: The condition Σβ λβφβ=e_y does not synthesize the probe integrand Σβ λβφβ(a)ψβ(z): two normalized instruments can contain the same effect e_y paired with different states, producing different contractions, so effect completeness alone cannot recover the atomic constraint (a_Y,z_Y)=(y,y).

soundness_flags.label: def:bow-positive-twin-construction
soundness_flags.one_line: The stated types leave T dimensionally unresolved: h indexes the m² columns (a,z) of A_b, whereas T is introduced as the response matrix for an m-state source, so g=T^{-1}h is not well-defined without an explicit m²-by-m² construction and source-response indexing.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1 states that Markovian models are identifiable when accessible instruments at every locus are marginally informationally complete.
The paper develops CADMG kernels and the fixing operation used to characterize identifiable effects in hidden-variable DAG models.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association 119(547), 1778–1793 (2024)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper reduces discrete causal-inference tasks to polynomial optimization and gives automated causal bounds; it does not state the proposed independent-edge shared-mechanism lift.
The paper establishes finite canonical SCM representations for discrete-domain counterfactual distributions and formulates corresponding polynomial programs.
The front-door criterion identifies P(y|do(x)) by summing P(z|x) times the treatment-averaged conditional outcome law under the stated positivity condition.
